items.t: ASML Stocks Edge Higher 0.07% as Dutch Government Pushes Back on U.S. Export Curbs
items.sum: The Hague says it will not be dictated to as Washington's MATCH Act threatens tighter limits on China, about 20% of ASML's revenue.

items.t: AMD vs. ASML: As Wall Street Questions the AI Boom, Which Chip Stock Wins in 2027?
items.sum: Amid a sharp semiconductor sell-off, differences in AMD's and ASML's growth prospects and valuations could determine which stock offers the stronger investment opportunity for 2027.

items.t: ASML Caught in US-China Chip Battle as Netherlands Vows to Resist Trump’s Proposed Export Curbs: ‘We Will Not Simply Be Told What to Do’
items.sum: The Dutch government plans to urge the U.S. not to impose proposed China export restrictions that could negatively affect chip equipment maker ASML and other European businesses if the MATCH Act is enacted.

items.t: ASML Can’t Build Enough Machines for 2028. Is a 20% China Risk a Reason to Sell, or Buy More?
items.sum: Key TakeawaysDutch lawmakers urged their government to resist the MATCH Act, which Congress may attach to its annual defense bill before the outgoing session ends. ASML expects China to supply about 20% of 2026 sales, or roughly €9 billion on guidance of €44 billion to €45 billion.

items.t: ASML Sinks 7% in a Week: Dutch Lawmaker Warns the MATCH Act Is “Disastrous for ASML.” Time to Buy?
items.sum: Key TakeawaysASML stock fell 7% in the past week in a chip selloff, and Applied Materials fell even more. A Dutch lawmaker called the US MATCH Act disastrous for ASML.
